title: alchemilla arvensis f. microcarpa
intro: Alchemilla arvensis f. microcarpa, commonly known as the small-fruited lady's mantle, is a variant of the Alchemilla arvensis plant, which is a flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce pain and inflammation, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla arvensis f. microcarpa include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic, making it useful for treating conditions such as menstrual cramps, digestive issues, and skin problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
